verdict.rationale: The evidence shows ongoing customer monitoring that can be toggled per customer, batch processing, and one-off exports over a chosen date range. None of these is a documented way for a user to schedule recurring jobs or workflows with a cron, interval, or frequency setting. Ongoing monitoring is an adjacent automatic feature, and exports are one-off actions rather than a recurring schedule, so neither earns credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
